title: Transition Encoding Coefficient
statement: For a finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input alphabet and $k$ work tapes, define the transition encoding coefficient by $2^k\,|\mathcal{Q}|\,2^{3k+7}(3k+8)$, where $\mathcal{Q}$ is the set of codec cases for $M$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
